'''2010 US West Nationals Day 1 Geoff Dearing DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Geoff Dearing]] at [[2010 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Mind Trick Don't Work On Me!
* '''Username:''' gdearing
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
